assumptions: S13 F and NTUA L counters are source-local; appended numbers are candidate labels, not a resolved floor crosswalk.
Standard slabs remain fixed concentric circles; public extensions are independent assemblies.
Core void envelopes are derived plan templates; no internal shaft area filled with slab.
Hotel/top slab thickness .225m is an editable mapping of the public-floor candidate, not a verified hotel schedule.

crown_detail.uncertainty: Roof radius, opening, circumferential mapping, chord/web sections, truss count, deployment and joints are unconfirmed candidate geometry. Elevation samples ±1.5m with unbounded drawing/version systematic error.

used_parameters.scale_method: 82.2m published inner-floor endpoint used solely as dimensional prior. Outer facade cannot be equated with this diameter. No calibrated camera or orthographic plan; width/depth ratios are adjustable photo-informed modelling candidates.
used_parameters.uncertainty: Metric error unbounded: oblique aerial, unknown lens/camera pose, roof height and hidden boundary. No perspective rectification performed. Local azimuth not geographic north. Roof curves, numeric dimensions, levels, facade joints and pavilions remain replacement-ready candidates.
